method: WebFetch of each official course page on courses.leeds.ac.uk (plain URL; ?query strings return 403) plus Leeds undergraduate fee pages on leeds.ac.uk and students.leeds.ac.uk. Retried stale pages twice; only course pages whose own start date/fee wording establishes 2027/28 entry were recorded; pages showing 2021-2026 entry content were left unresolved.

universityWideStatements.quote: In November 2025, the UK government announced its intention to increase the tuition fee cap to £9,790 for the 2026/27 academic year and £10,050 for the 2027/28 academic year.
universityWideStatements.title: Undergraduate fees | University of Leeds
universityWideStatements.appliesTo: Government fee-cap announcement (under the heading for 2026/27 starters). It is a cap statement, not a per-course fee, so it was NOT used to fill any course fee.
